name: Scattegories
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y redis-server && npm install

terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.command: REDIS_HOST=127.0.0.1 REDIS_PORT=6379 PORT=3000 npm run dev
terminals.description: Scattegories Express + Socket.IO dev server (tsx watch) on http://localhost:3000, backed by the local Redis started in the start command.
